# sai-humanizer

> sai-humanizer: De-AI text humanizer with 55+ pattern taxonomy.
> Two-pass pipeline: deterministic pattern removal + statistical burstiness enforcement.
> Built by Sai Likhith Kanuparthi, part of the reliability layer for production AI in regulated industries.

## What it does

sai-humanizer detects and removes AI writing patterns from text. It uses a two-pass pipeline:

1. Deterministic pass: regex-based removal of em-dashes, 55+ AI vocabulary words, 40+ AI phrases, sycophantic openers, filler, and copula avoidance.
2. Statistical pass: burstiness scoring (sentence length coefficient of variation), triadic parallelism detection, bold-lead monotony flagging, and title case heading detection.

## Key features

- 55+ AI-tell taxonomy (the most comprehensive open-source pattern list)
- Three modes: technical, marketing, resume
- CLI with check mode for CI pipelines
- Python library with importable Humanizer class
- Zero runtime dependencies (stdlib only)
- Burstiness scorer that quantifies how AI-like text rhythm is
